steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Full house!

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Straight flush!

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: You little sack of shite, you've been hiding cards, haven't ya?

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Why'd I need to hide cards to beat you? Just sit yourself down like a good boy—

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: Royal flush.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Goddammit, how'd you pull that one off?!

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: Your sleeve, Jack.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Eh? My—How'd you catch that?

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Jack, you cheating bastard!

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Hey, if you didn't catch me, that's your problem.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: You want a problem? I'll shove your goddamn head so far up your arse that—

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: Just shuffle already.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Alright, shuffling, shuffling.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: I've sure got some rotten luck, getting stuck with you sorry lot for this shift.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Doesn't matter who you're on shift with, you're playing cards anyway. And there's only a handful of fellas here who won't try to cheat you. Go on, have a count.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: At least there hasn't been much to do today.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: You can say that again. Back when the old man said he'd take us sightseeing, I didn't believe him for one second.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Now that it's been a month, I'd say I believe him.

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: It's been good eating and good drinking.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Certainly has! It feels like my appetite's gone back to when I just enlisted.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: Ahhh!!!

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: What the hell are you screaming out for, Charles?! Scared the crap outta me!

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: Bloody hell, I had another nightmare.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: Dreamt that I got chopped in half by a Sarkaz sword and all.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Gah, thought it'd be something worse. Day afore yesterday I dreamt that I got blown up by some Originium explosives while out scouting.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: Right now I'd like to shove some explosives into your gob.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Well hurry up already then.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: A guy nuttier than a freaking Vampire out on the battlefield is going to have a few screws loose when off the warfront.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: Well, what can I do? I can't control if I have a nightmare or not.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Just think positive. Last time you said you were being minced, this time you said you were being chopped in two.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Maybe it's a good omen or something.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: Dammit, you're right.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Alright, enough moping, grab a drink and come play some cards.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Perfect timing really. Now that you're up, come take over my spot for a few rounds.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: Why, is something the matter?

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Not really. There's a few farmers at the bottom of the mountain that need a hand with their work, so I'm going to help out.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: Farmers?

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: That family that gives us milk all the time, the Turiels.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Oh, I remember them. Their daughter's quite pretty.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Heh, I see how it is, Lisburn.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: I'm just helping out. Don't read too much into it.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: The hell are you lot doing? Everyone within a hundred meters could hear you yapping away.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You sure have some skills, turning the barracks into your gambling parlor.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Didn't you say we were going to go sightseeing from the start, though?

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: We're just following orders here.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I told you, you can go help out the locals a bit for some goodwill, let them think we're more than just a bunch of yobs. Have you been yet?

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Lisburn's going to help out. He's keeping mum, but I can tell that he's thinking of settling down here.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Don't listen to this nutter, boss. I really am just going there to help out.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: After all, we came here to...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Alright, that's enough out of you.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Just get going already. Who died and made you chief worrywart, huh?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: If a young lad like yourself really does want to become a family man, I'd say you're still a good egg.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: You've sure got a stink about you, boss.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Still working on your veterinary medicine out there?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Save it. Lily, the Leones' girl, she gave birth prematurely.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Didn't get there in time, all I could do was help with some postpartum care.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: *sigh* And then I ran into this one very unlucky chap.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Unlucky?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Another Victorian.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: A Victorian? The whole month we've been here I bet I've seen, if not a thousand Victorian tourists, eight hundred at least.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Alright, I get it, you love taking a stroll down the street.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Deal those cards out already.

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: I'll deal.

steps.name: Silent Soldier
steps.text: Charles had a nightmare again, boss.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Did he?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Let me see.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: It's fine, no use troubling yourself over it.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: If you lot die, then who's going to fight for me?

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: We're going to fight?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Shut your mouth for a second and hold still, alright?

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: Gah—

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hmm... Well, at least it hasn't gotten worse.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Does it still hurt as much as last time?

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: It's been a lot better since we came to Kjerag.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hmph, I spent a lot of money greasing palms just to get this opportunity. If you lot aren't feeling any healthier, doesn't it seem like I wasted all that dosh for nothing?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Besides, it's not like there's anything else to do here except get better.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: Heh, you're right about that, sir.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: This arm's been no good for a while, but you've already helped me a lot.

steps.name: Sickly Soldier
steps.text: If I ever lose both my arms, well, at least I can still carry a weapon into battle with my teeth.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: What use is a soldier with no arms?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: There's no need to show off. You lads just need to remember that you're here to—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Allow me to remind you once more, My Lord.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You have a duty you are obligated to carry out. Do not fail Her Grace.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: This is not a sightseeing trip.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Hey, boss?

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: You finally gone senile?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I'm not the same as you simpletons who care nothing for your health.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: When you've gone senile, I'm still going to be fit as a fiddle.

spans.text: gone senile, I'm still going to be fit as a fiddle.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Hey, we might not even get to live that long.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Forget it.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: For the sake of my retirement, this old fogey's willing to go all in.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: I don't think a hoity-toity lord like you throwing your money around is going to fit in well with the locals, honestly.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: But nobody's going to turn down a sumptuous banquet.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You go on and play your cards.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Sure you're not just looking for an excuse to drop a crappy hand?

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Let me see...

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Four Jacks, not great, not terrible.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hah! Now that hits the spot!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Enciodes sent it over specially, said it would be given out at the bonfire banquet the night before the ceremony. That uh, what was it called again...?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: 'Karlan Manor's Snow Realm Spring', Sir!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: They've been talking about it on television every day, enough times that I've memorized it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Pah, it's all just claptrap for the masses!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I will say that this drink is exquisite. Very robust. I dare say it's the one good thing Enciodes has done.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: However! It hardly holds a candle to our very own aged Paleroche akvavit!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Should we keep drinking this stuff, Sir?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Counting what we got from the Browntails, there's still three other drinks to try.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Of course we'll keep drinking it! If we don't try for ourselves then how will we know which is the best?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Since the Saintess has bestowed the privilege of organizing the banquet on Clan Paleroche, this is of course one of my duties.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Drink is our top priority! I must pick Kjerag's best spirits for this banquet! I cannot let the Saintess down!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Alright, go, get the rest of the booze up here for a taste test!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Yes, Sir!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Guards, with me! Let's carry up those drinks!

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: General, I have a question.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: Although the Patriarch did say that this is all preparation for the ceremony just now, isn't this way too much booze?

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: The boys are totally worn out.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: You're thinking too much. Completing Kjeragandr's statue is more important than any amount of booze.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Ask the men to bear with it for a while longer. When everything's settled, I'll treat you all to a fine meal.

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: Alright then.

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (The Paleroches could stand to be a bit more attentive.)

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (I didn't think infiltrating them would be this easy.)

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (Their former patriarch's already brought Rosalind over.)

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (Next, I need to check what exactly Clan Paleroche has up its sleeve.)

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (Moreover—All this booze... Based off of Arctosz's attitude, is it really all for the banquet?)

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (Yet another trail to follow.)

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: What's with all the lollygagging? Come over and help out already.

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (But if the Paleroches truly are keeping some terrible secret, Rosalind must surely be involved as well.)

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (Finding her has become a priority.)

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: We have arrived.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Is this your house?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: These rooms are pretty big. Are you one of those low-key rich guys? You don't look it.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Hardly. This is merely some family property.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Ahem. Look here, young lady.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: This house is built right into the mountain. When you begin your climb tomorrow, you can use the shortcut behind it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Thanks a lot, batyushka.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I should apologize to you first.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Eh? But why though?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I invited you here out of my own selfish desire.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: By Kjeragandr, I should not have hidden this from you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Why are you all serious all of a sudden?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I can handle it. Just lay it on me.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Oh, child...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: There is someone I would like you to meet.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: He...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Master?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: There's a real big guy yelling for you over there, batyushka.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: He your son?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: He's certainly no son of mine.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Give me a moment, young lady.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: What are you doing back, Sir?!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Am I not allowed back?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: That's not what I mean!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: It's just... *sigh* It's not a great time for you to be here...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Great time or not, you're in no place to speak of such things!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: How is Arctosz?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: He... Sir Arctosz, he...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Out with it already! Speak clearly!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Sir Arctosz is currently making preparations for the bonfire banquet!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Don't just give me the good news! What else?!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: He's personally checking all the drinks for tomorrow. Right now, he's sampling those from the other regions...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Rotten boy...!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: He said he would give up drinking last month, and now this? Ridiculous!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: If he keeps flip-flopping, how is anyone supposed to trust a word out of his mouth?!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: The patriarch is doing this all for the sake of politics. He's fully dedicated to the Saintess...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Pfah! Sounds like excuses to me!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Haha... Oh, by the way. Who's the girl?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: How rude, Gulo!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: The young lady is Rosalind, my guest.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Welcome, Madam Rosalind.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: (Master, who is Madam Rosalind really?)

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: (It might just be me, but she looks a bit like Sir Arc—)

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: (Shh!)

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: (I'm not certain of anything yet. Don't ask too many questions just now.)

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Gulo, bring the young lady inside first.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: And then... Wherever that oaf Arctosz is, take her to him.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: And don't forget to tell your minions to prepare a room and meal for her. Treat her well, or else.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Yes, Sir!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: No biggie.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You guys finished chatting?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What was it you were going to tell me before that big guy came over?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Someone you wanted me to meet, right?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: The man that I wish for you to meet is inside the house.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Follow this one inside first. Your meeting with this man will make everything clear.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What about you, batyushka? Not coming with?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: We will meet again soon, child.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Very soon...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Please, come with me, Madam Rosalind.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, bratan, your name is Gulo, right?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What were you chatting with the old man about?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Something you can't tell me?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: C'mon, bratan, say something.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: (*making an X with his fingers*)

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You really can't say?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: (*yet another X, followed by a constant barrage of Xs*)

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Urgh... Fine, I'll stop bothering you about it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Anyway, as soon as I meet this guy, I'll know, right? I'm also real curious as to why you two keep staring at my face.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What, is it 'cause I look like someone, or does someone look like me?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Nah, can't be, the way the old man talked about the guy he wants me to meet, it's like—

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: That—It's not—Well, no...!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright, calm down, a guy like you couldn't lie your way out of a finbowl.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well, I'm not lying, you guys were stealing some real strange glances earlier.

spans.text: not lying, you guys were stealing some real strange glances earlier.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: If you're up to some funny business, it's gonna come down to my fists.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Weren't we going inside? C'mon already.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Ah! Madam Rosalind!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Sir Arctosz, Master has brought us a guest...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Sir?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Wahahaha! This is a fine drink, incredibly fine!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Come, finish this glass with me!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hahaha!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: This is the guy the old man wanted me to meet?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: A... bearded drunk?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What's this girl babbling about?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I am Arctosz, Patriarch of the Paleroche Clan. How could I possibly get drunk on a sip of wine?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: All the drunks say stuff like that.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And here I thought... Nah, couldn't be, my papa would definitely be way cooler.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You're Father's guest, *hic* so I won't argue with you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Still...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Come a bit closer, girl. Let me have a proper look.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wha—What the hell are you trying to pull?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I... I feel like your face is sort of familiar...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*...
The old man steps inside, disturbing a thick layer of dust.
The door barely hangs on its hinges, and the floor creaks with every step.
Under his orders, the room has not welcomed a single guest in a very, very long time.
With no residents, and no custodians, this forgotten room has fallen apart with age.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Where did I put it?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I think it was...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: ...Ah, good, here it is.
The old man fiddles with the latch of a cabinet in the corner, removing something from within.
It's a plain, unadorned rock, every edge painstakingly polished smooth until it was perfectly round.
Upon the rock is carved a blessing of Kjeragandr.
The old man grasps the rock in the palm of his hand.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Thank goodness...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I kept it, even as I never expected this day to come.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Rosalind has grown up well, Tatyana...
The old man remembers. That day was also a winter's day.
It was through this very window that he had watched that sad, silent parting.
He had seen that young, foreign, faultless woman, with her anger and disappointment that could light snow aflame, leave.
He had seen that young, confused child carried in her mother's arms, unable to understand the reason behind her mother's furious face.
He had watched them for what felt like centuries.
Watched them until their backs faded into the bitter white winds.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: So many years, and with so much time passed.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I had planned to give this to Rosalind, but I never expected...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Arctosz did not want to see you two bear the blame, and so I locked this room, and told him that he must not speak in your stead.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: And then it was I, for the sake of Clan Paleroche, who exiled you and yours.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: If there is anyone to blame, Tatyana, then blame me.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Now, the Paleroche clan is in Arctosz's hands.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Kjerag too, is not as she once was.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I pledged to live the rest of my days as a simple devotee, so that as long as I lived, I would keep the road ahead clear for Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: If only it had been like this...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I must be truly old now, daydreaming like that.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: By Kjeragandr...
